pr_body:
Handle SPI/I2c interface in the dts.

Support multiple instances.

Tested with nucleo_f446re.

Fixes #49019

issue_context.title: Fix multiple issues with adxl372 driver
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
The adxl372 driver has many issues, it uses a Kconfig to select if it uses SPI or I2C interface which leads to undefined operation, this should be handled in the dts instead. It also does not support multiple instances, nor can it cope with 2 devices on SPI and I2C simultaneously, therefore the driver needs to be updated and fixed to support this and prevent firmware from crashing at start up.

**Impact**
Showstopper
